sections.name: File setup, DocumentModule
sections.title: Module setup and wiring
sections.what: Lists the controller and the service, imports the storage module, and exports the service so other features can use it.
sections.why: Standard wiring so the framework can create the feature's parts.
sections.watch_out: Anything the service needs that this module does not import must be provided by another module.

summary: Groups the document controller and document service into one feature and states which outside services it uses.
purpose: Tells the app how to assemble the document feature so its routes and logic are available when the app starts.
why: Standard NestJS wiring. Likely reason: keeping the feature's parts in one module makes it easy to load.
how: 1) Load the controller and the service. 2) Import the storage module so the service can use file storage. 3) Register the controller and the service. 4) Export the service so other features can use it.
inputs: None directly. The module relies on the storage module and on any shared modules the app provides.
outputs: A module the app loads, which exposes the document routes and the document service.
risks: The service also needs the database, file processing and audit services, and this file does not import them. They must be provided by another module, and a missing one causes a failure at startup.
debug: If the app fails to start with a missing provider error, find the service named in the error and confirm its module is loaded or global. If document routes return not found, confirm the controller is registered here.
